propositions: Pass-1 discards per-call usage attached to runner results, so batch outputs and coverage.metrics lack token totals for the most expensive pass.
The three pass functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) are changed to return (findings, usage) pairs and summarize_for_isf returns (text, usage), with every caller updated atomically.
Usage is aggregated per call and derived into per-criterion maps, with multi-criterion chunks splitting token fields equally while counting requests and llm_calls in full.
Checkpoint-served chunks and ladder attempts that raise contribute no usage record, while every completed ladder attempt mints its own record.
run_focused_finder is extended to return (records, findings, usage) summed over its internal run_bin calls and merged into BatchRunResult.outputs['_usage'].
The sidecar payload gains coverage.usage with exact keys per_call and per_criterion, and _attach_plan_review_metrics folds token totals into coverage.metrics.
